doctrinal_frame.excerpt: Long parameter lists obscure the relationship between caller and callee; introduce a Parameter Object or Preserve Whole Object to recover intent.
Deeply nested control flow signals missing guard clauses; collapse the arrowhead with early returns and extracted predicates.
A switch keyed on type or tag is the primary signal for Replace Conditional with Polymorphism; the cases want to be subclasses or strategy callables.
A class accreting attributes and behavior past the comfortable-craft band has acquired multiple responsibilities; extract collaborators along the responsibility seams.
A method that talks more to another object than to itself is asking to be moved; relocate the behavior to where the data lives.

doctrinal_frame.citation: What Every Programmer Should Know About Object-Oriented Design — Connascence of Type
doctrinal_frame.excerpt: Strings and ints standing in for domain concepts produce connascence of type across the call graph; introduce small value objects to localize the connascence.
Parameters that travel together signal a missing record type; bundling them as a value object reduces the data-coupling surface across the call graph.
